description: Modern building with dark glass facade and prominent white grid framework, wide light-colored paved street or plaza, row of large light-colored planters, Speed Limit 25 sign on a pole, tall dark reflective glass building with distinctive spired roofline, older light-colored multi-story buildings in the background.

Left building with rust-colored arched base and dark angular upper structure, urban street with cracks, modern dark glass skyscraper with pointed spires, traditional multi-story building with facade and windows.

Modern building entrance, multi-paneled glass facade reflecting other buildings, "PPG PLACE" sign reflected on an upper left glass panel, light-colored segmented opaque wall base, wide dark recessed entrance with faintly visible ceiling lights, set of straight light grey stairs with two metallic handrails, continued multi-paneled glass facade and light-colored segmented opaque wall base.
